events.title: Patch Notes - v1.15
events.summary: A few minor updates:Fixed bug that building npcs could get stuck in prior room if players run to next room firstAdded floating balls and adjusted water characteristics in Duck Pool (challenge 2)

events.title: Patch notes - v1.13 (demo content update)
events.summary: Hi folks, the v1.13 update to the demo released today adds a bunch more content. Rather than just the first rest area and first challenge, the demo now includes challenges 1-3 along with the second rest area and the race car minigame and claw machine minigame. So about 1/3 of the content of the full game.Summary of changes:Added challenge 2 to demoAdded challenge 3 to demoAdded rest area 2 to demoAdded race car game to demoAdded claw machine game to demoAdded coins to demoFixed some dialogue and

events.title: Patch Notes - v1.12
events.summary: Updates in this patch:Fixed a couple strings in Chinese translationsReworked safe tiles in tile jumping game so player can land on edge between tiles of same color (if that color is the next color)Faded tile game victory music when warping to other mini gamesAdded lights to shooting game and racing game for night usageAdded an indicator for the player's car at the start of the race gameFixed bug that challenge 4 bug bassinet was swinging according to frame rate instead of delta timeUpdated music

events.title: Patch Notes - v1.11
events.summary: Some minor updates:Some grammar and typos in dialogue fixedAdded signs for playing the already-seen minigames from other areasAdded claw machine to the first rest area in case any coins left at end of dayMoved tile jumping victory coin so it's still obtainable if tile jumping game played at end of dayAdded reticle to the shoot mini game

events.title: Patch Notes - v1.9
events.summary: A few updates in v1.9:Made test room door close when player enters lobby to prevent cheating.Fixed bug that game state was not being updated to record the number of races won by player.Added a failure sound effect in tile game when landing on wrong color.Have shut off hidden colliders for npcs going home to prevent them getting stuck against benches.Disable the minigames when it's time to go home when train ride skipped.Adjusted size and positioning of you win text in race game so better visible

events.title: Patch Notes - v1.8
events.summary: A few minor updates in version 1.8:Fixed bug allowing talking to npcs that had just become invisible.Updated credits content.Made sure building 1 npc explains that no guessing required.Fixed bug that the race car crash noises were really quiet when player actually in game.Minor updates to some other npc dialogue.

events.title: Patch Notes - v1.7
events.summary: A few minor updates including:dialogue updates for Judy, Aaron, Eric, and momrace car game now detects player win properly even when very close finishclaw machine music bug fixedballoon colors added and more balloon objects in claw machines

events.title: Demo released!
events.summary: The demo for 3 Switch Problem is now released. It's just the first area and challenge number 1 but should give you a taste of what the full game will be like.Version 1.5 includes a few small updates, including:Sun and clouds now move in the sky over timeMinor changes to reduce warnings when running on old computers in compatibility graphics mode
